Additionally, after obtaining all of the above rewards, the player obtains 50 R Jewels for every additional 500,000 points they earn.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event. The player can trade their EX Jewels for Gold and cards. Each card can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.

When Dueling against Jesse Anderson Level 40 or higher (in both regular and Underworld Duels), these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
